---
title: "ELISA QC report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 4
    toc_float: true
params:
  prep: ""
  exclusions: NULL
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 1, dpi = 96)
prep <- readRDS(params$prep)
info <- prep$info
data <- prep$data
qc <- info$qc
group_col <- qc$group_col
batch_col <- qc$batch_col
log_scale <- isTRUE(qc$log_scale)
matched <- JanisHelpers:::match_sample_exclusions_(data, params$exclusions, info$assay)
means <- JanisHelpers:::elisa_qc_means_(data)
scored <- JanisHelpers:::qc_table_score_(means, "analyte", group_col, log_scale)
or_unset <- function(x) if (is.null(x)) "not set" else paste0("`", x, "`")

emit_plot <- function(p) {
  if (is.null(p)) return(invisible(NULL))
  h <- JanisHelpers:::qc_fig_height_(length(unique(p$data$.row)))
  env <- new.env()
  env$p <- p
  wd <- getwd()
  on.exit(setwd(wd), add = TRUE)
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    text = c(sprintf("```{r, fig.height = %s, fig.width = 10}", h), "print(p)", "```"),
    envir = env, quiet = TRUE
  ), "\n\n")
}
note <- function(...) cat("\n\n*", ..., "*\n\n", sep = "")
```

## Overview

| | |
|---|---|
| File | `r basename(info$source_path)` |
| Assay | `r info$assay` |
| File modified | `r if (file.exists(info$source_path)) format(file.mtime(info$source_path), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") else "not found"` |
| Prep result created | `r format(info$created_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")` |
| JanisHelpers | `r info$package_version` |
| Group / batch column | `r or_unset(group_col)` / `r or_unset(batch_col)` |
| Replicate CV limit | `r qc$max_cv`% |

All samples are shown. Rows on the exclusions sheet are only flagged here;
they are dropped at the final export.

```{r overview}
overview <- data |>
  dplyr::distinct(mouse_ID, tissue, collected_at) |>
  dplyr::mutate(timepoint = JanisHelpers:::qc_timepoint_(collected_at)) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n(), .by = c(tissue, timepoint)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(tissue, match(timepoint, JanisHelpers:::qc_timepoint_levels_(timepoint)))
knitr::kable(overview, caption = "Samples per tissue x timepoint")
```

## Completeness

```{r completeness, results = "asis"}
comp <- JanisHelpers:::qc_table_completeness_(data, qc$expected_mice)
unknown <- attr(comp, "unknown")
missing <- comp[comp$missing != "", ]
if (nrow(missing) == 0) {
  cat("None missing (", length(qc$expected_mice), " expected mice).\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("**Warning: expected mice missing.**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(missing))
}
if (length(unknown) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n**Warning: mice in the data that are not expected:** ",
      paste(unknown, collapse = ", "), ".\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Exclusions

```{r exclusions, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(matched$applicable) == 0) {
  cat("No exclusions apply to this assay.\n")
} else {
  cat("Flagged samples (dropped at the final export):\n\n")
  if (nrow(matched$excluded_samples) > 0) {
    print(knitr::kable(matched$excluded_samples))
  }
}
if (nrow(matched$unmatched) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Warning: these rows match no sample\n\n",
      "Check for typos -- the final export stops on them.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(matched$unmatched))
}
```

## Empty values

Empty (`NA`) values are out-of-range readings or missing measurements.

```{r empty, results = "asis"}
empty <- JanisHelpers:::qc_table_empty_(data, "analyte")
cat(sum(empty$n_empty), " of ", nrow(data), " values empty.\n\n", sep = "")
print(knitr::kable(empty))
```

## Range

OOR = reported out of range by the instrument software; LLOQ / ULOQ = numeric
values below / above the quantification limits.

```{r range}
knitr::kable(JanisHelpers:::elisa_qc_range_(data))
```

## Replicate agreement

```{r replicates, results = "asis"}
reps <- JanisHelpers:::elisa_qc_replicates_(data, qc$max_cv)
if (nrow(reps) == 0) {
  cat("All replicate CVs are within ", qc$max_cv, "%.\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("**Warning: replicate CV above ", qc$max_cv, "%.**\n\n", sep = "")
  reps$cv <- round(reps$cv, 1)
  print(knitr::kable(reps))
}
```

## Outliers

Replicate means; labelled points lie outside their boxplot's whiskers (more
than 1.5 x IQR beyond the quartiles) within group x tissue x timepoint x
analyte.

```{r no-group, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(group_col)) {
  note("Group column not set -- rerun the prep script with `group_col` to score outliers.")
}
```

### By group

```{r outliers, results = "asis"}
emit_plot(JanisHelpers:::qc_table_plot_(scored, "analyte", group_col, log_scale))
```

### By batch

```{r batch, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(batch_col)) {
  note("Batch column not set -- rerun the prep script with `batch_col`.")
} else {
  emit_plot(JanisHelpers:::qc_table_plot_(scored, "analyte", group_col,
                                          log_scale, batch_col = batch_col))
}
```

### Over time

```{r time, results = "asis"}
p <- JanisHelpers:::qc_table_time_plot_(means, "analyte", group_col)
if (is.null(p)) note("Fewer than two sampling dates -- no time course.") else emit_plot(p)
```

## Flagged samples

```{r flags, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(group_col)) {
  note("Not scored -- group column not set.")
} else {
  flags <- JanisHelpers:::qc_table_flag_table_(scored, "analyte")
  if (nrow(flags) == 0) {
    cat("No samples flagged.\n")
  } else {
    cat("Ranked by the number of analytes flagged.\n\n")
    flags$excluded <- ifelse(flags$mouse_ID %in% matched$excluded_samples$mouse_ID,
                             "excluded", "")
    print(knitr::kable(flags))
  }
}
```
